semiconductor_relevance: High — Vieworks develops advanced industrial cameras that are critical for machine vision applications in semiconductor manufacturing and quality control.
summary: Vieworks Co., Ltd. specializes in the development of high-resolution industrial cameras that enhance machine vision capabilities in automation processes. Their innovative technologies, such as pixel shift and hybrid TDI sensors, enable precise inspection and quality control in semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Ultra high resolution industrial cameras using pixel shift technology
Hybrid TDI sensors combining CMOS and CCD strengths
Thermoelectric cooling technology for sensor temperature management
High-speed CoaXPress-over-Fiber cameras delivering up to 1000 fps
